title: Kotigobba 3
desc: After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.

title: Chandu
desc: Chandu, a college student, beats up a gangster for his unjust acts. Fearing the wrath of the gangster, his parents send him to Bengaluru, where he meets the love of his life.

title: Ayushman Bhava
desc: When faced with a family crisis, Govindan and Soorya choose to end their lives at a suicide point. However, they decide to find another way to solve their issues.

title: Aajay
desc: Ajay, a kabaddi player, hides Padma from Veerabhadra, a gangster who wants to force her into marrying him. Soon, the two fall in love.

title: Bahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.
